Three of the 12 mention arbitration:

- **Acme_MSA.pdf**, §14.2
- **Brightline_SOW.docx**, §9
- **Northwind_NDA.pdf**, §11

Eight other files were searched and have no mention. The twelfth, **Vendor_Agreement_2019.pdf**, is a scanned image with no extractable text, so I couldn't check it. It needs OCR or a manual read before you can treat the list as complete.
